note: Permanent safehouse upgrades (engine/upgrades*.js). An upgrade is a ROW: id (the server's upgrade id: supabase/migrations/20261105000032 seeds arma_upgrade_defs with these ids, maxLevel and prices, and a test pins the two), maxLevel, prices (the cash price of level 1, 2, ... in order; the server charges its own copy) and effect (what each level does on the phone: reserveMagazines adds perLevel spare magazines of roundsPerMagazine[resource] rounds to that resource's carry cap; maxStamina adds perLevel to the player's maximum stamina; dodgeRecovery shortens the dodge's recovery by perLevel of the whole recovery per level). Levels are bought one at a time, in order, with cash the server has granted. The levels come from the writer (api.calls.get) and are cached in localStorage under cacheKey so they still apply offline; a panel with no server answer is locked. Words are in webText.json under the upgrades. ids. enabled false or ?noupgrades=1 hides the panel; the cached levels then still apply, so a full rollback ships the previous release. limits are the validator's bounds (maxLevels and maxPrice mirror arma_upgrade_defs; maxDodgeCut is the most of a roll's recovery the upgrade may remove). refreshMs is how long an answer is trusted before the next safehouse visit asks again; retryMs the wait after a failed ask; percentScale turns a share (0.3) into the percentage the dodge line shows (30).
